newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends unchanged in dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends unchanged in dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished flat at 42.5495/5500 to the dollar in interbank trading in yet another dull session ahead of Thursday' public holiday, dealers said.
Dealers said there were few deals, like in past few days, amid scarce supply of the U.S. currency.
"It seems banks are not willing to sell at this rate. The trend may continue until taka is made weaker," said one dealer.
The call money rates ended unchanged at 6.0 to 7.0 percent, and dealers said they might remain steady until next week's auction of Bangladesh (central) Bank bill.
